name: mip-hfsp-project-generator-skill
description: Skill package for generating Gurobi-based HFSP scheduling research projects with txt data, index.json, modular src (metaheuristics/math_models), 5 default algorithms (SA/MA/IG/GA/TS), three-layer scripts (single/bench/batch), ablation/DOE/statistics, and LaTeX paper writing structure.
